fresh_online.scope: Keep these families separate. Natural Main and Heldout Replay differ in requests,traces and output contract. They are not an output-only A/B.

H1_full_model_compilation.finding: Strong Stock remains full-model compiled. Qualified Layer and Hybrid serial P kernels are shorter than Native. Compiler-only causal contribution is not isolated.

H2_extra_continuation_and_handoff.scope: Added-path existence and measured serial cost,not exclusive Main causal shares.
H2_extra_continuation_and_handoff.finding: Serial N3 observes added D-first kernel and host cost. P kernel savings nearly cancel added D-first kernels. Main post-P host paths are longer. Exclusive DMA remains unmeasured.

H3_P_queue.scope: Observed host-path location,not an exclusive GPU causal share.
H3_P_queue.finding: Layer versus Stock has a longer pre-P-ready host path. Native-relative comparison has a different critical path. Host enclosures do not identify request-exclusive GPU compute.

H4_D_admission.finding: Same Stock cap0-to2 raises TTFT p95 and lowers goodput in Natural N3 and length-matched Replay N3. Registration-open moves waiting after acceptance without reproducible TTFT recovery.

H5_policy_concurrency.finding: Exact one-signature-field interventions retain endogenous batching and queue feedback. Earlier safe coordinator credit return does not consistently reduce TTFT. Source windows still differ in common-D Native comparisons.

falsifications: Fresh uncapped Stock Native-relative TTFT regression is not statistically confirmed in either family. Do not force the historical premise onto the fresh family.
Better ITL and TPOT do not imply better joint attainment. Same-axis D cap control reproduces this tradeoff.
Removing registration waiting does not remove total D waiting.
Earlier safe credit return does not always improve online TTFT.
Best-family Layer,Token and Hybrid do not have matched offloaded rows. Inherited target metadata is not matching proof.
measurement_limits: Main400 Natural per-request exclusive GPU operator and DMA times are NOT_MEASURED.
Stock serial profiler observer interference exceeds5percent. Its first capture stays DIAGNOSTIC and subsequent two are NOT_RUN.
Qualified serial Batch1 Output16 measurements are not Main400 Natural operator fractions.
Logical scheduler overlap is not physical GPU idle,exclusive causal delay or a safe future window.
Old-to-fresh runtime bridge changes several common host and priming details. It is not a one-factor intervention.
Frozen-path and metric-gate oracles do not update queues,KV,ITL,outputs or cohort duration. They are not achievable speedups or global bounds.
All N3 empirical confidence intervals are pointwise and unadjusted. Requests and tokens are not independent server starts.
